name: cheez
title: Cheez — Full Collection
description: The typed Cheez component with 60 pen-mark types and three drawing characters.

"use client"

import { createCheezMark } from "../cheez-core/create-cheez-mark"
import { underlineDefinitions } from "./underline.definition"

export const Underline = createCheezMark(
  "Underline",
  underlineDefinitions,
  "#ff5c35",
)

  "Circle",
  circleDefinitions,
  "#6558f5",
)

"use client"
